filter: centered box mean, exact piecewise-linear integral, future-only full support; no padding, no extrapolation
width_rule: nearest 10 ms to 1/median history frequency of 96 frozen train-main windows; sensitivity nearest 10 ms to 1/min frequency. No prediction metrics used.

methods.A: original nominal position-clock targets minus original instantaneous truth_initial; predictions minus initial
methods.B: native measured-rate interpolation at nominal model physical times, minus native interpolated value at t0; model unchanged
methods.C: box mean of A response, preserving original instantaneous anchor; can be nonzero at first valid center
methods.D: box mean of B response, preserving physical instantaneous anchor
methods.C_cycle: C minus C at first full-window center W/2; later cycle-average change, not response from original t0
methods.D_cycle: D minus D at first full-window center W/2; later cycle-average change, not response from original t0

alignment: No time shift fitted. Model output time remains its native dt/position-clock contract; stale initial is not repaired. Native truth at the same nominal physical time is an offline reference.
